mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and pressure corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive up costs and pressure corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth declines by > 3pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive up borrowing costs and pressure corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the housing starts index, signals a weakening housing market that will drag on consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST growth declines by > 10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating pace of job growth, as measured by the 3-month change in nonfarm payrolls, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month PAYEMS growth accelerates by > 200k jobs/mo but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in consumer prices, as measured by the year-over-year change in the consumer price index, signals rising inflation that will erode consumer purchasing power and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y CPIAUCSL inflation rises above 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp widening of the spread between the federal funds rate and the consumer price index signals a tightening of financial conditions that will pressure corporate profit margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL spread widens by > 2pp but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
